scope.symbol_subselection: NONE_IN_THIS_PREFLIGHT; select only after a prospectively defined data-completeness and event-independence audit over the eligible frame
missing_pre_outcome_features: full-frame historical data availability and completeness
scope.missingness_rule: UNKNOWN_REMAINS_UNKNOWN; do not impute absent history, event counts, costs, or margin data; do not treat the 41 structural representatives as proxies for the 1576-member frame

coarse_parameter_regions.range_rationale: Four geometrically spaced 1-to-8-hour context windows, three separated deviation strengths, and 15-to-60-minute responses form a small, mechanism-interpretable coarse surface without optimizing against observed outcomes.

design.estimand: For each frozen cell, the arithmetic mean of UTC-date-cluster means of signed forward log returns divided by event-time rolling one-bar-return standard deviation times sqrt(holding_horizon); the return sign is reversed for positive deviations and preserved for negative deviations, so positive values indicate movement toward the rolling mean.
design.causal_event_rule: At each completed M5 close, use only that close and the immediately preceding frozen lookback closes to calculate the arithmetic rolling center and population standard deviation; emit a short event at z >= threshold and a long event at z <= -threshold; zero-scale windows emit no event.
design.dependence_unit: UTC calendar date pooled across all included symbols and events; average event responses within each date before inference. Effective independent sample size is date-level n divided by 1 + 2 times the sum of positive date-series autocorrelations, stopping at the first non-positive lag and bounded to [1,n].
design.missing_data: No forward fill, interpolation, resampling, or synthetic bars. Gaps break contiguous segments; events whose frozen forward horizon crosses a gap are right-censored, retained in trigger/censor counts, and excluded from settled-response estimates. Missing symbols/dates are not imputed.
design.exploratory_multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR q=0.05 across all 36 frozen cells; record every cell and all failed/insufficient cells. This exploratory adjustment is not confirmatory authority.
design.selection_rule: Retain broad connected adjacent parameter regions only; isolated supported cells cannot be promoted. Freeze all outcomes and probes in the region table. Do not narrow symbols from observed outcomes; any later panel selection must use only the frozen pre-outcome features.

power_design.sample_size_unit: effective independent UTC dates, not M5 bars or raw events

data_boundary.later_request_interval: Must be frozen from the materialized scope and accepted-history coverage; no default multi-year download.
